entries.text: You see before you Uthern, leader of the Super Mutants.
entries.source_text: You see before you Uthern, leader of the Super Mutants.

entries.text: Normie! How dare you enter the confines of your betters?
entries.source_text: Normie! How dare you enter the confines of your betters?

entries.text: Huh?
entries.source_text: Huh?

entries.text: Scum like you could never be better than humans!
entries.source_text: Scum like you could never be better than humans!

entries.text: Die Mutie!!
entries.source_text: Die Mutie!!

entries.text: Really? You claim yourself better, but what proof do you have?
entries.source_text: Really? You claim yourself better, but what proof do you have?

entries.text: If you consider yourself one better than the rest, you run into the fallacy of over generalization.
entries.source_text: If you consider yourself one better than the rest, you run into the fallacy of over generalization.

entries.text: It's a wonder your race survived as long as it has. I will start with you in the cleansing.
entries.source_text: It's a wonder your race survived as long as it has. I will start with you in the cleansing.

entries.text: You only prove my point by using inane comments as such. I personally would not wish you in my sight, but my master would have words with you.
entries.source_text:
You only prove my point by using inane comments as such. I personally would not wish you in my sight,
 but my master would have words with you.

entries.text: Show me your master.
entries.source_text: Show me your master.

entries.text: Try these words -- Drop dead!
entries.source_text: Try these words -- Drop dead!

entries.text: Surely one of your intellect can see that such things will solve nothing.
entries.source_text: Surely one of your intellect can see that such things will solve nothing.

entries.text: With pleasure.
entries.source_text: With pleasure.

entries.text: Are you claiming that talk will solve nothing? You are more foolish than I thought.
entries.source_text: Are you claiming that talk will solve nothing? You are more foolish than I thought.

entries.text: Though you are foolish, I was referring to your manner of delivering words.
entries.source_text: Though you are foolish, I was referring to your manner of delivering words.

entries.text: Ah, the fool finally realizes something.
entries.source_text: Ah, the fool finally realizes something.

entries.text: Words will only do so much. This will solve more.
entries.source_text: Words will only do so much. This will solve more.

entries.text: I begin to think you may have a bit of superior blood in you yet. Let me find out for certain.
entries.source_text: I begin to think you may have a bit of superior blood in you yet. Let me find out for certain.

entries.text: He does indeed, for death shall be your saving grace.
entries.source_text: He does indeed, for death shall be your saving grace.

entries.text: The simplest of proofs for you. I am smarter, stronger, and quicker than you are. Would you care for a test of my skills?
entries.source_text:
The simplest of proofs for you. I am smarter, stronger, and quicker than you are. Would you care
 for a test of my skills?

entries.text: No, thanks. I believe you.
entries.source_text: No, thanks. I believe you.

entries.text: You forgot arrogant, stupid and ugly.
entries.source_text: You forgot arrogant, stupid and ugly.

entries.text: Sure. Let's see what you can do.
entries.source_text: Sure. Let's see what you can do.

entries.text: Good. Would you like a chance at gaining greater powers?
entries.source_text: Good. Would you like a chance at gaining greater powers?

entries.text: You bet!
entries.source_text: You bet!

entries.text: No way!
entries.source_text: No way!

entries.text: I'm not sure about this.
entries.source_text: I'm not sure about this.

entries.text: Die!
entries.source_text: Die!

entries.text: Then i will take you to my master.
entries.source_text: Then i will take you to my master.

entries.text: It almost seems a pity. No matter, this won't take long.
entries.source_text: It almost seems a pity. No matter, this won't take long.

entries.text: Offered all the power in the world and still frightened. I will help you with your decision.
entries.source_text: Offered all the power in the world and still frightened. I will help you with your decision.

entries.text: Comments such as those only prove how much more intelligent i am than you. Now, you shall pay for your insolence!
entries.source_text: Comments such as those only prove how much more intelligent i am than you. Now, you shall pay for your insolence!

entries.text: Do you accept credit cards, or only caps?
entries.source_text: Do you accept credit cards, or only caps?

entries.text: Never!!
entries.source_text: Never!!

entries.text: Sorry, I'm a little low on caps right now. Can I get a raincheck?
entries.source_text: Sorry, I'm a little low on caps right now. Can I get a raincheck?

entries.text: What? I think I can generalize this much -- you are coming with me now.
entries.source_text: What? I think I can generalize this much -- you are coming with me now.

entries.text: How nice to see you again. I was told that you were roaming around here. I have orders to bring you in.
